traceability.notes: The story 025.0-DEV-CATCH-ANNOTATION-POSITION is fully implemented. CatchClause annotation detection now supports both positions (before-catch and inside-catch) with a clear precedence favoring before-catch annotations. Fallback logic covers both getCommentsInside and line-based scanning of the catch body. Auto-fix has been updated so that for CatchClause nodes it inserts annotations as the first comment lines inside the catch block body, aligning with Prettier’s formatting behavior. These behaviors are thoroughly covered by unit tests (catch-position and catch-insert-position helpers), integration tests that run Prettier and ESLint together, and the main require-branch-annotation rule tests. Rule documentation explicitly describes the allowed CatchClause positions, Prettier compatibility, precedence rules, and auto-fix behavior. All Jest tests pass, indicating no regressions. Therefore, all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are satisfied.
